t: Forge Steel 8-piece box spanner set provides a comprehensive range of twin-ended metric spanners, essential for various trade applications. Constructed from durable carbon steel, each spanner is designed to withstand rigorous use in demanding environments. The set is particularly effective for fitting back nuts to monobloc taps, and for accessing fasteners in recessed or deep set locations, making it an indispensable addition for plumbers, mechanics, and general maintenance professionals. The corrosion-resistant spanners feature 2 sliding bars, allowing optimal leverage when dealing with hard-to-reach nuts and bolts. Ideal for a wide variety of workshop and garage tasks.
